```python
def build_remediation_section(remediations: Dict[str, Any], only_text: bool
    =False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns, kwargs: Optional[Dict
    [str, Any]]=None) ->List[str]:
    """
    Build the remediation section.

    Args:
        remediations (Dict[str, Any]): Remediation details.
        only_text (bool, optional): Whether to return only text without styling. Defaults to False.
        columns (int, optional): Number of columns for formatting. Defaults to terminal size.
        kwargs (Optional[Dict[str, Any]], optional): Additional arguments for formatting. Defaults to None.

    Returns:
        List[str]: Formatted remediation section.
    """
    if not kwargs:
        kwargs = {}
    
    if not remediations:
        return []
    
    lines = ['   REMEDIATIONS']
    
    if is_using_api_key():
        # With API key - show detailed remediations
        for pkg_name, versions in remediations.items():
            for version_spec, remediation in versions.items():
                vuln_count = remediation.get('vulnerabilities_found', 1)
                vuln_text = 'vulnerability' if vuln_count == 1 else 'vulnerabilities'
                
                version = remediation.get('version', '')
                recommended = remediation.get('recommended_version', '')
                
                msg = f"\n-> {pkg_name} version {version} was found, which has {vuln_count} {vuln_text}\n"
                msg += f"   The closest version with no known vulnerabilities is {recommended}\n"
                
                other_versions = remediation.get('other_recommended_versions', [])
                if other_versions:
                    versions_str = ', '.join(other_versions)
                    msg += f"{' ' * 78}\n"
                    msg += f"   We recommend updating to version {recommended} of {pkg_name}. Other versions\n"
                    msg += f"   without known vulnerabilities are: {versions_str}\n"
                else:
                    msg += f"{' ' * 78}\n"
                    msg += f"   We recommend updating to version {recommended} of {pkg_name}.\n"
                
                more_info_url = remediation.get('more_info_url', '')
                if more_info_url:
                    msg += f"{' ' * 78}\n"
                    msg += f"   For more information about the {pkg_name} package and update options, visit\n"
                    msg += f"   {more_info_url}\n"
                
                msg += f"   Always check for breaking changes when updating packages.\n"
                msg += f"{' ' * 78}"
                
                lines.append(msg)
    else:
        # Without API key - show commercial message
        rem_count = get_remediations_count(remediations)
        pkg_count = len(remediations)
        
        vuln_text = 'vulnerability' if rem_count == 1 else 'vulnerabilities'
        pkg_text = 'package' if pkg_count == 1 else 'packages'
        
        msg = f"\n  {rem_count} {vuln_text} was reported in {pkg_count} {pkg_text}. For detailed remediation & fix \n"
        msg += f"  recommendations, upgrade to a commercial license. \n"
        
        lines.append(msg)
    
    lines.append('+==============================================================================+')
    
    return lines
```
